title: Ulyana and the Choir
author: Beatrix Crane
blurb: Tamsin Zhou, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
